info.name: Epic Boon Category Feats
info.description: The Epic Boon Category Feats from the Player’s Handbook 2024.
info.author: Wizards of the Coast

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Peerless Aim. When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until the start of your next turn.

sheet.description: When you miss with an attack roll, you can hit instead.

select.name: Ability Score Increase (Boon of Combat Prowess)

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Blink Steps. Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30 feet to an unoccupied space you can see.

sheet.description: Immediately after you take the Attack action or the Magic action, you can teleport up to 30ft. to an unoccupied space you can see.

select.name: Ability Score Increase (Boon of Dimensional Travel)

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Improve Fate. When you or another creature within 60 feet of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. Once you use this benefit, you can't use it again until you roll Initiative or finish a Short or Long Rest.

sheet.description: When you or another creature within 60ft. of you succeeds on or fails a D20 Test, you can roll 2d4 and apply the total rolled as a bonus or penalty to the d20 roll. You also regain a use of this feature whenever you roll Initiative.

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Strength or Dexterity score by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Overcome Defenses. The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance.

Overwhelming Strike. When you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal extra damage to the target equal to the ability score increased by this feat. The extra damage's type is the same as the attack's type.

select.name: Ability Score Increase (Boon of Irresistible Offense)

description.p: Increase your Strength by 1, to a maximum of 30. Additionally, when you roll a 20 on the attack roll, you deal extra damage equal to your Strength score.

sheet.description: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance. Additionally, whenever you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal {{overwhelming strike:damage}} extra damage of the same type as the attack's type to the target.

description.p: Increase your Dexterity by 1, to a maximum of 30. Additionally, when you roll a 20 on the attack roll, you deal extra damage equal to your Dexterity score.

sheet.description: The Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage you deal always ignores Resistance. Additionally, whenever you roll a 20 on the d20 for an attack roll, you can deal {{overwhelming strike:damage}} extra damage of the same type as the attack's type to the target.

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+, Spellcasting Feature)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase your Intelligence, Wisdom, or Charisma score by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Free Casting. Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1-4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

sheet.description: Whenever you cast a spell with a level 1-4 spell slot, roll 1d4. If the number you roll is the same as the slot's level, the slot isn't expended.

select.name: Ability Score Increase (Boon of Spell Recall)

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.

Merge with Shadows. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can give yourself the invisible condition as a Bonus Action. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction.
Shadowy Form. While within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

sheet.description: While within Dim Light or Darkness, you can become Invisible. The condition ends on you immediately after you take an action, a Bonus Action, or a Reaction. Additionally, while within Dim Light or Darkness, you have Resistance to all damage except Psychic and Radiant.

select.name: Ability Score Increase (Boon of the Night Spirit)

description.p: Epic Boon Feat (Prerequisite: Level 19+)
You gain the following benefits.
Ability Score Increase. Increase one ability score of your choice by 1, to a maximum of 30.
Truesight. You have Truesight with a range of 60 feet.
